We have an opening for a Professor or Associate Professor of Interactive Media "with an emphasis on interactive storytelling, worldbuilding, and/or playful design in the public interest". The successful candidate would become a tenured faculty member in the Film and Media Arts division of the School of Communication at American University. We'll begin reviewing applications on November 1, 2026, with an anticipated start date of August 2027.
